content.name: Callum Brennan
content.title: Early Career Teacher of Science (Chemistry)
content.summary: Chemistry graduate in my second ECT year at an 11–18 academy in Sheffield, teaching KS3 science and GCSE chemistry. Before training I tutored GCSE students, and in my first year my Year 10 set's mock results rose by an average of one grade.

experience.title: Science Tutor (part-time)
bullets: Tutored 9 GCSE students a week in chemistry and combined science alongside my PGCE.
Built a bank of 60 exam-style retrieval quizzes mapped to the AQA specification.
All 9 students met or beat their target grades in summer 2024.

experience.title: Early Career Teacher of Science
bullets: Teach 7 classes across KS3 science and GCSE chemistry, about 190 students, in an 11–18 academy with 46% of pupils eligible for pupil premium.
Raised my Year 10 set's mock results by an average of one grade between autumn and summer using weekly low-stakes retrieval and live modelling.
Run the Year 8 STEM club for 25 pupils and entered a team in a regional chemistry competition, where they placed third.
Following my ECT induction programme with a school-based mentor, with fortnightly observations rated as meeting all Teachers' Standards.

education.details: Placements in two Sheffield secondary schools.

achievements.detail: Awarded in 2024 on completing the PGCE.
